core_obligations: Reduce to the case where U satisfies condition (3) of the quasi-compactness lemma, in which the statement is immediate from the covering-surjection lemma (proof lines 5307-5310).
In general, use the definition of quasi-compactness to obtain a refinement V -> U of the given covering whose index image I' in I is finite (proof lines 5311-5319).

Verify exactness of the displayed sequence: by the exactness criterion it suffices to apply Hom into an arbitrary module, and the resulting sequence is the standard one for the lower shriek construction, completing the proof up to line 5334 (proof lines 5320-5334).
proof_roadmap: Handle the stronger quasi-compactness case directly.
In general choose a refinement with finite index image.
Test exactness after applying Hom into an arbitrary module.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a covering {U_i -> U} with U quasi-compact, some finite subfamily I' already gives an exact sequence presenting j_!O_U by the extensions by zero along the members of the subfamily and their pairwise fibre products. The proof first reduces to the case where U satisfies a stronger quasi-compactness condition, then in general uses the definition of quasi-compactness to find a refinement V of the covering U whose index image I' is finite, and checks exactness of the resulting sequence by applying Hom into an arbitrary module and using the standard sequence coming from the lower shriek construction (proof lines 5306-5334). H2: the reduction to a finite-index refinement and the Hom-test for exactness are the substance; the author explicitly says the reader may skip the general case, which is nonetheless written out.
